scripts.script:
-- Jarona Delta Dash Script + On-Screen Control Button + Help Menu Panel
-- Binds to 'Q' on PC, features an on-screen Dash Button, and an interactive Help UI.

local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")
local CoreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local rootPart = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")

-- Dash Configuration Settings
local DASH_SPEED = 110          
local DASH_DURATION = 0.25      
local COOLDOWN = 1.0            
local TrailColor = Color3.fromRGB(0, 100, 255) 

local onCooldown = false

-- 1. Create the Main UI Container
local JaronaGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
JaronaGui.Name = "JaronaSystemUI"
JaronaGui.ResetOnSpawn = false

if syn and syn.protect_gui then
    syn.protect_gui(JaronaGui)
    JaronaGui.Parent = CoreGui
else
    JaronaGui.Parent = CoreGui
end

-- 2. Create the On-Screen Dash Button
local DashButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
DashButton.Name = "DashButton"
DashButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 85, 0, 85)
DashButton.Position = UDim2.new(0.85, 0, 0.7, 0)
DashButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 20)
DashButton.BorderSizePixel = 2
DashButton.BorderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
DashButton.Text = "DASH\nQ"
DashButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
DashButton.Font = Enum.Font.Code
DashButton.TextSize = 18
DashButton.Parent = JaronaGui

local ButtonCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
ButtonCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)
ButtonCorner.Parent = DashButton

-- 3. Create the "?" Help Launcher Button
local HelpButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
HelpButton.Name = "HelpButton"
HelpButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 35, 0, 35)
HelpButton.Position = UDim2.new(0.85, 25, 0.7, -45) -- Placed neatly right above the dash pad
HelpButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 35)
HelpButton.BorderSizePixel = 1
HelpButton.BorderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
HelpButton.Text = "?"
HelpButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
HelpButton.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
HelpButton.TextSize = 16
HelpButton.Parent = JaronaGui

local HelpCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
HelpCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
HelpCorner.Parent = HelpButton

-- 4. Create the Hidden Deltarune Help Panel
local HelpPanel = Instance.new("Frame")
HelpPanel.Name = "HelpPanel"
HelpPanel.Size = UDim2.new(0, 320, 0, 240)
HelpPanel.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -160, 0.5, -120) -- perfectly centered
HelpPanel.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(10, 10, 15)
HelpPanel.BorderSizePixel = 2
HelpPanel.BorderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
HelpPanel.Visible = false -- Starts hidden hidden until toggled
HelpPanel.Active = true
HelpPanel.Draggable = true
HelpPanel.Parent = JaronaGui

local PanelCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
PanelCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
PanelCorner.Parent = HelpPanel

-- Help Panel Title
local HelpTitle = Instance.new("TextLabel")
HelpTitle.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 35)
HelpTitle.BackgroundTransparency = 1
HelpTitle.Text = "★ JARONA SYSTEM HELP ★"
HelpTitle.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 0)
HelpTitle.Font = Enum.Font.Code
HelpTitle.TextSize = 16
HelpTitle.Parent = HelpPanel

-- Help Content/Controls Info Text
local HelpContent = Instance.new("TextLabel")
HelpContent.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 1, -80)
HelpContent.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 40)
HelpContent.BackgroundTransparency = 1
HelpContent.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
HelpContent.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
HelpContent.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 240)
HelpContent.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans
HelpContent.TextSize = 16
HelpContent.Text = [[
[ CONTROLS ]
• PC / Keyboard: Press 'Q' to execute.
• Mobile / Tablet: Tap the on-screen 'DASH' button.

[ CURRENT ENGINE STATS ]
• Dash Velocity Speed: ]] .. DASH_SPEED .. [[ power
• Slip Window Duration: ]] .. DASH_DURATION .. [[s
• Cooldown Rate: ]] .. COOLDOWN .. [[s

[ CREDIT ]
• Jarona Deltarune Chapter 5 Meme Replication
]]
HelpContent.Parent = HelpPanel

-- Panel Dismiss Close Button
local CloseHelp = Instance.new("TextButton")
CloseHelp.Size = UDim2.new(0, 100, 0, 30)
CloseHelp.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -50, 1, -40)
CloseHelp.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 40, 40)
CloseHelp.BorderSizePixel = 0
CloseHelp.Text = "Close"
CloseHelp.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
CloseHelp.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
CloseHelp.TextSize = 14
CloseHelp.Parent = HelpPanel

local CloseCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
CloseCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
CloseCorner.Parent = CloseHelp


-- 5. Core Visual Effects Functions (Trails)
local function spawnTrailClone(bodyPart)
    if not bodyPart:IsA("BasePart") then return end
    
    local clone = bodyPart:Clone()
    clone.Anchored = true
    clone.CanCollide = false
    clone.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
    clone.Color = TrailColor
    clone.Transparency = 0.4
    
    for _, child in ipairs(clone:GetChildren()) do
        if not child:IsA("SpecialMesh") then
            child:Destroy()
        end
    end
    
    clone.Parent = workspace
    
    local fadeTween = TweenService:Create(clone, TweenInfo.new(DASH_DURATION, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), {
        Transparency = 1,
        Size = clone.Size * 0.9
    })
    
    fadeTween:Play()
    Debris:AddItem(clone, DASH_DURATION)
end

-- 6. Core Dash Mechanics Engine
local function performJaronaDash()
    if onCooldown or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return end
    onCooldown = true
    
    DashButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 40, 40)
    DashButton.Text = "CD"

    local moveDirection = humanoid.MoveDirection
    if moveDirection.Magnitude == 0 then
        moveDirection = rootPart.CFrame.LookVector
    end
    
    local bodyVelocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
    bodyVelocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(100000, 100000, 100000)
    bodyVelocity.Velocity = moveDirection.Unit * DASH_SPEED
    bodyVelocity.Parent = rootPart
    
    local bodyGyro = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
    bodyGyro.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(100000, 100000, 100000)
    bodyGyro.CFrame = rootPart.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-65), 0, 0)
    bodyGyro.D = 100
    bodyGyro.P = 10000
    bodyGyro.Parent = rootPart

    local trailActive = true
    task.spawn(function()
        while trailActive do
            for _, limb in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
                if limb:IsA("BasePart") and limb.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
                    spawnTrailClone(limb)
                end
            end
            task.wait(0.05)
        end
    end)
    
    task.wait(DASH_DURATION)
    bodyVelocity:Destroy()
    bodyGyro:Destroy()
    trailActive = false
    
    task.wait(COOLDOWN)
    DashButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 20)
    DashButton.Text = "DASH\nQ"
    onCooldown = false
end

-- 7. Interaction Event Hook Handlers
UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
    if gameProcessed then return end
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Q then
        performJaronaDash()
    end
end)

DashButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    performJaronaDash()
end)

-- Help Panel Open/Close Toggle Handlers
HelpButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    HelpPanel.Visible = not HelpPanel.Visible
end)

CloseHelp.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    HelpPanel.Visible = false
end)

-- Character Auto-Rehook Stability Controller
player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(newCharacter)
    character = newCharacter
    rootPart = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
end)

scripts.script:
--// SKY HOP V2 YE
--// Dark Glass + Blue Accent | Mobile Friendly
--// Place in StarterPlayer > StarterPlayerScripts

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

--==================================================
-- CONFIG
--==================================================

local DEFAULT_HEIGHT = 200
local MIN_HEIGHT, MAX_HEIGHT = 50, 500

local DEFAULT_DISTANCE = 75
local MIN_DISTANCE, MAX_DISTANCE = 50, 100

local DEFAULT_INTERVAL = 1
local MIN_INTERVAL, MAX_INTERVAL = 0.25, 5

local ACCENT = Color3.fromRGB(85, 145, 255)
local PANEL_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(18, 20, 28)
local PANEL_TRANSPARENCY = 0.08

--==================================================
-- STATE
--==================================================

local height = DEFAULT_HEIGHT
local distance = DEFAULT_DISTANCE
local interval = DEFAULT_INTERVAL
local panelTransparency = PANEL_TRANSPARENCY

local hoverEnabled = false
local sideEnabled = false
local equipEnabled = false
local autoReturnEnabled = false

local character, humanoid, root, backpack
local anchorPosition
local sideDirection = Vector3.xAxis
local sideOffset = 0
local sideSign = 1
local sideTimer = 0
local equipTimer = 0

local activeSlider
local alive = true
local minimized = false
local characterGeneration = 0

--==================================================
-- CHARACTER HELPERS
--==================================================

local function getRoot()
    character = player.Character
    if not character then return false end

    humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    backpack = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")

    return humanoid ~= nil and root ~= nil
end

local function stopMovement()
    hoverEnabled = false
    sideEnabled = false
    anchorPosition = nil
    sideOffset = 0
    sideTimer = 0
end

local function prepareAnchor()
    if not getRoot() then
        return false
    end

    anchorPosition = root.Position

    local look = root.CFrame.RightVector
    sideDirection = Vector3.new(look.X, 0, look.Z)

    if sideDirection.Magnitude < 0.01 then
        sideDirection = Vector3.xAxis
    else
        sideDirection = sideDirection.Unit
    end

    sideOffset = 0
    sideSign = 1
    sideTimer = 0

    return true
end

--==================================================
-- GUI
--==================================================

local oldGui = playerGui:FindFirstChild("SkyHopV2YE")
if oldGui then
    oldGui:Destroy()
end

local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "SkyHopV2YE"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.IgnoreGuiInset = false
gui.DisplayOrder = 20
gui.Parent = playerGui

local main = Instance.new("Frame")
main.Name = "Main"
main.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(300, 440)
main.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -150, 0.5, -220)
main.BackgroundColor3 = PANEL_COLOR
main.BackgroundTransparency = PANEL_TRANSPARENCY
main.BorderSizePixel = 0
main.Parent = gui

Instance.new("UICorner", main).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 14)

local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
stroke.Color = ACCENT
stroke.Transparency = 0.55
stroke.Thickness = 1
stroke.Parent = main

local header = Instance.new("Frame")
header.Name = "Header"
header.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 48)
header.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 30, 43)
header.BorderSizePixel = 0
header.Parent = main

Instance.new("UICorner", header).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 14)

local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -90, 1, 0)
title.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 0)
title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
title.Text = "SKY HOP  /  V2 YE"
title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(235, 240, 255)
title.TextSize = 15
title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
title.Parent = header

local minimize = Instance.new("TextButton")
minimize.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(34, 30)
minimize.Position = UDim2.new(1, -42, 0, 9)
minimize.Text = "—"
minimize.TextSize = 18
minimize.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
minimize.TextColor3 = ACCENT
minimize.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(38, 43, 59)
minimize.BorderSizePixel = 0
minimize.Parent = header

Instance.new("UICorner", minimize).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)

local body = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
body.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 56)
body.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 1, -66)
body.BackgroundTransparency = 1
body.BorderSizePixel = 0
body.ScrollBarThickness = 3
body.ScrollBarImageColor3 = ACCENT
body.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
body.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
body.ScrollingDirection = Enum.ScrollingDirection.Y
body.Parent = main

local list = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
list.Padding = UDim.new(0, 9)
list.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
list.Parent = body

local padding = Instance.new("UIPadding")
padding.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 10)
padding.Parent = body

--==================================================
-- UI HELPERS
--==================================================

local function makeLabel(text, parent)
    local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, 24)
    label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    label.Text = text
    label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(190, 199, 218)
    label.TextSize = 12
    label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
    label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    label.Parent = parent or body
    return label
end

local function makeButton(text, parent, color)
    local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
    button.Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, 38)
    button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 35, 48)
    button.BorderSizePixel = 0
    button.Text = text
    button.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(235, 240, 255)
    button.TextSize = 12
    button.Font = Enum.Font.GothamSemibold
    button.AutoButtonColor = true
    button.Parent = parent or body

    Instance.new("UICorner", button).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 9)

    local outline = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    outline.Color = color or ACCENT
    outline.Transparency = 0.72
    outline.Parent = button

    return button
end

local function makeSlider(labelText, minVal, maxVal, initial, callback)
    local holder = Instance.new("Frame")
    holder.Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, 55)
    holder.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    holder.Parent = body

    local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    label.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 22)
    label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(215, 224, 243)
    label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
    label.TextSize = 12
    label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    label.Parent = holder

    local bar = Instance.new("TextButton")
    bar.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 30)
    bar.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 16)
    bar.Text = ""
    bar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(42, 47, 62)
    bar.BorderSizePixel = 0
    bar.AutoButtonColor = false
    bar.Parent = holder

    Instance.new("UICorner", bar).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

    local fill = Instance.new("Frame")
    fill.Name = "AccentFill"
    fill.BackgroundColor3 = ACCENT
    fill.BorderSizePixel = 0
    fill.Size = UDim2.new(
        (initial - minVal) / (maxVal - minVal), 0, 1, 0
    )
    fill.Parent = bar

    Instance.new("UICorner", fill).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

    local knob = Instance.new("Frame")
    knob.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 12)
    knob.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
    knob.Position = UDim2.new(fill.Size.X.Scale, 0, 0.5, 0)
    knob.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    knob.BorderSizePixel = 0
    knob.Parent = bar

    Instance.new("UICorner", knob).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

    local value = initial

    local function setFromX(x)
        local width = bar.AbsoluteSize.X
        if width <= 0 then return end

        local alpha = math.clamp(
            (x - bar.AbsolutePosition.X) / width, 0, 1
        )

        value = minVal + (maxVal - minVal) * alpha
        value = math.floor(value * 100 + 0.5) / 100

        local shown = value
        if maxVal > 5 then
            shown = math.floor(value + 0.5)
        end

        fill.Size = UDim2.new(alpha, 0, 1, 0)
        knob.Position = UDim2.new(alpha, 0, 0.5, 0)
        label.Text = labelText .. "  •  " .. tostring(shown)

        callback(value)
    end

    label.Text = labelText .. "  •  " .. tostring(initial)

    bar.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            activeSlider = bar
            setFromX(input.Position.X)
        end
    end)

    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if activeSlider == bar and (
            input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
        ) then
            setFromX(input.Position.X)
        end
    end)

    UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            activeSlider = nil
        end
    end)

    return holder
end

--==================================================
-- DRAGGING
--==================================================

local dragging = false
local dragInput
local dragStart
local startPosition

header.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
    or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragging = true
        dragStart = input.Position
        startPosition = main.Position

        input.Changed:Connect(function()
            if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                dragging = false
            end
        end)
    end
end)

header.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
    or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragInput = input
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if dragging and (
        input == dragInput
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
    ) then
        local delta = input.Position - dragStart

        main.Position = UDim2.new(
            startPosition.X.Scale,
            startPosition.X.Offset + delta.X,
            startPosition.Y.Scale,
            startPosition.Y.Offset + delta.Y
        )
    end
end)

minimize.Activated:Connect(function()
    minimized = not minimized
    body.Visible = not minimized

    main.Size = minimized
        and UDim2.fromOffset(300, 48)
        or UDim2.fromOffset(300, 440)

    minimize.Text = minimized and "+" or "—"
end)

--==================================================
-- MOVEMENT CONTROLS
--==================================================

local function updateButton(button, name, enabled)
    if not button then return end

    button.Text = name .. "     [" .. (enabled and "ON" or "OFF") .. "]"
    button.BackgroundColor3 = enabled
        and Color3.fromRGB(36, 57, 88)
        or Color3.fromRGB(30, 35, 48)
end

local hoverButton = makeButton("AUTO HOVER  [OFF]")
local sideButton = makeButton("SIDE TELEPORT  [OFF]")
local equipButton = makeButton("AUTO EQUIP SLOT 1  [OFF]")
local respawnButton = makeButton("AUTO RETURN ON RESPAWN  [OFF]")

local status = makeLabel("STATUS  •  Ready")
status.Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, 30)

hoverButton.Activated:Connect(function()
    if not hoverEnabled then
        if not prepareAnchor() then return end
        hoverEnabled = true
    else
        hoverEnabled = false

        if getRoot() then
            anchorPosition = root.Position
            sideOffset = 0
        end
    end

    updateButton(hoverButton, "AUTO HOVER", hoverEnabled)
end)

sideButton.Activated:Connect(function()
    if not sideEnabled then
        if not anchorPosition then
            if not prepareAnchor() then return end
        end

        sideEnabled = true
        sideOffset = 0
        sideSign = 1
        sideTimer = 0
    else
        sideEnabled = false
        sideOffset = 0
    end

    updateButton(sideButton, "SIDE TELEPORT", sideEnabled)
end)

equipButton.Activated:Connect(function()
    equipEnabled = not equipEnabled
    updateButton(equipButton, "AUTO EQUIP SLOT 1", equipEnabled)
end)

respawnButton.Activated:Connect(function()
    autoReturnEnabled = not autoReturnEnabled

    updateButton(
        respawnButton,
        "AUTO RETURN ON RESPAWN",
        autoReturnEnabled
    )

    status.Text = autoReturnEnabled
        and "STATUS  •  Auto return enabled"
        or "STATUS  •  Auto return disabled"
end)

--==================================================
-- SETTINGS
--==================================================

makeLabel("MOVEMENT SETTINGS")

makeSlider("Hover height (studs)", MIN_HEIGHT, MAX_HEIGHT,
    DEFAULT_HEIGHT, function(v)
        height = v
    end)

makeSlider("Side distance (studs)", MIN_DISTANCE, MAX_DISTANCE,
    DEFAULT_DISTANCE, function(v)
        distance = v
    end)

makeSlider("Side interval (seconds)", MIN_INTERVAL, MAX_INTERVAL,
    DEFAULT_INTERVAL, function(v)
        interval = v
    end)

makeLabel("APPEARANCE")

makeSlider("Panel transparency (%)", 0, 70, 8, function(v)
    panelTransparency = v / 100
    main.BackgroundTransparency = panelTransparency
end)

local accentButton = makeButton("CHANGE ACCENT COLOR")

local accentColors = {
    Color3.fromRGB(85, 145, 255),
    Color3.fromRGB(175, 110, 255),
    Color3.fromRGB(65, 220, 190),
    Color3.fromRGB(255, 135, 160),
    Color3.fromRGB(255, 190, 85),
}

local accentIndex = 1

accentButton.Activated:Connect(function()
    accentIndex = accentIndex % #accentColors + 1
    ACCENT = accentColors[accentIndex]

    stroke.Color = ACCENT
    accentButton.TextColor3 = ACCENT
    body.ScrollBarImageColor3 = ACCENT

    for _, obj in ipairs(gui:GetDescendants()) do
        if obj:IsA("UIStroke") then
            obj.Color = ACCENT
        elseif obj:IsA("Frame") and obj.Name == "AccentFill" then
            obj.BackgroundColor3 = ACCENT
        end
    end
end)

--==================================================
-- RESPAWN HANDLING
--==================================================

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
    characterGeneration += 1
    local thisGeneration = characterGeneration

    -- Stop movement using the previous character.
    stopMovement()

    character = char
    humanoid = nil
    root = nil

    status.Text = "STATUS  •  Waiting for character"

    task.spawn(function()
        local newHumanoid = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 10)
        local newRoot = char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 10)

        if thisGeneration ~= characterGeneration then
            return
        end

        if not newHumanoid or not newRoot then
            status.Text = "STATUS  •  Character unavailable"
            return
        end

        humanoid = newHumanoid
        root = newRoot
        backpack = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")

        if autoReturnEnabled and humanoid.Health > 0 then
            -- Use the new spawn point as the anchor.
            anchorPosition = root.Position

            local look = root.CFrame.RightVector
            sideDirection = Vector3.new(look.X, 0, look.Z)

            if sideDirection.Magnitude < 0.01 then
                sideDirection = Vector3.xAxis
            else
                sideDirection = sideDirection.Unit
            end

            sideOffset = 0
            sideSign = 1
            sideTimer = 0

            -- Resume hovering with the selected height.
            hoverEnabled = true
            sideEnabled = false

            updateButton(hoverButton, "AUTO HOVER", true)
            updateButton(sideButton, "SIDE TELEPORT", false)

            status.Text = "STATUS  •  Returning to sky"
        else
            updateButton(hoverButton, "AUTO HOVER", false)

local resetButton = makeButton("Reset", UDim2.new(0.5, 5, 0, 135), Color3.fromRGB(150, 60, 60))

local createdOverlays = {}

	status.Text = msg
	status.TextColor3 = color or Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 190)
end

local function parseId(text)
	return string.match(text, "%d+")
end

local function applyImage(id)
	local assetUrl = "rbxassetid://" .. id
	local count = 0

	for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		if obj:IsA("Texture") or obj:IsA("Decal") then
			local part = obj.Parent
			if part and part:IsA("BasePart") then
				if obj.Transparency > 0 then
					local overlay = Instance.new("Decal")
					overlay.Name = "ReplacerOverlay"
					overlay.Face = obj.Face
					overlay.Texture = assetUrl
					overlay.Transparency = 0
					overlay.Color3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
					overlay.Parent = part
					table.insert(createdOverlays, overlay)
				else
					table.insert(originalTextures, { obj = obj, texture = obj.Texture })
					obj.Texture = assetUrl
				end
				count += 1
			end
		end
	end

	return count
end

local function resetAll()
	for _, data in ipairs(originalTextures) do
		if data.obj and data.obj.Parent then
			data.obj.Texture = data.texture
		end
	end
	table.clear(originalTextures)

	for _, overlay in ipairs(createdOverlays) do
		if overlay then
			overlay:Destroy()
		end
	end
	table.clear(createdOverlays)
end

	end

	setStatus("Objects replaced: " .. count, Color3.fromRGB(120, 220, 140))
end)

	setStatus("Textures reset", Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 190))
end)

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local noclipEnabled = false

local function setNoclip(enabled)
    noclipEnabled = enabled
    print("Noclip: " .. (enabled and "ON" or "OFF"))
end

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
    if processed then return end

    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.N then
        setNoclip(not noclipEnabled)
    end
end)

RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
    if not noclipEnabled then return end

    local character = player.Character
    if not character then return end

    for _, part in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
        if part:IsA("BasePart") then
            part.CanCollide = false
        end
    end
end)

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
    task.wait(0.5)
    if noclipEnabled then
        setNoclip(true)
    end
end)
scripts.features: Noclip
